sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Help from Klaus
At [[Huntik Foundation Italian HQ]], the Huntik team find [[Klaus]]' statue, whom [[Zhalia]] turned to stone with [[King Basilisk]]. After turning him back, Zhalia and the team ask him for help to recover the [[Amulet]] of [[Void]]. Klaus recalls the stories of the [[Spiral Mark]] and devastation that would take place if the Amulet fell into the wrong hands. To the team's relief, he agrees to help.

;Organization Territory 
At Klaus's Bookstore, the team are ambushed by [[Wilder]] and the [[Organization]]. A fight ensues but the Huntik team defeat them and, with assistance from [[Springer]], make their way down into the vault. They are ambushed again by [[Stack]] and [[Dark Dryad]], but Lok manages to recover Void's Amulet from the vault. However, a alarming warning from a terrified [[Eathon Lambert]] via the [[Holotome]] tells Lok that something terrible is going to happen.

;A New Faction
Both Factions are startled when another group arrives to claim Void: The [[Blood Spiral Brotherhood]]. With masses of [[Silent Soldiers]], and their [[Titans]], [[Harlekin]] and [[Marauder]], the Blood Spiral are extremely powerful. [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]] defeat [[Wilder]], [[Stack]] and the rest of the Organization easily. [[Dante]] attempts to disrupt the powerful [[Shakrit]] by using [[Archwarder]], but their old enemy [[Rassimov]] emerges from the shadows and uses [[Darkvoid]] to destroy his [[Amulet]]. As the Spirals close in, it looks like the end for [[Dante]].

;The Powerbond
With one final chance, he calls on [[Caliban]], powerbonding with the Titan and fighting back against the Spiral's powerful forces. However [[Shauna]] overpowers [[Lok]] and claims the Amulet of Void. Victorious, the Spirals leave, burning Klaus' base to the ground in the process, with the team barely make it out alive. Zhalia is saddened at the loss of her only real home growing up while Dante must make a full report to the Huntik council. Lok and Sophie inform [[Lucas Casterwill]] of what has happened.
sections.text:
Help from Klaus
At Huntik Foundation Italian HQ, the Huntik team find Klaus' statue, whom Zhalia turned to stone with King Basilisk. After turning him back, Zhalia and the team ask him for help to recover the Amulet of Void. Klaus recalls the stories of the Spiral Mark and devastation that would take place if the Amulet fell into the wrong hands. To the team's relief, he agrees to help.

Organization Territory
At Klaus's Bookstore, the team are ambushed by Wilder and the Organization. A fight ensues but the Huntik team defeat them and, with assistance from Springer, make their way down into the vault. They are ambushed again by Stack and Dark Dryad, but Lok manages to recover Void's Amulet from the vault. However, a alarming warning from a terrified Eathon Lambert via the Holotome tells Lok that something terrible is going to happen.

A New Faction
Both Factions are startled when another group arrives to claim Void: The Blood Spiral Brotherhood. With masses of Silent Soldiers, and their Titans, Harlekin and Marauder, the Blood Spiral are extremely powerful. Shauna and Wind defeat Wilder, Stack and the rest of the Organization easily. Dante attempts to disrupt the powerful Shakrit by using Archwarder, but their old enemy Rassimov emerges from the shadows and uses Darkvoid to destroy his Amulet. As the Spirals close in, it looks like the end for Dante.

The Powerbond
With one final chance, he calls on Caliban, powerbonding with the Titan and fighting back against the Spiral's powerful forces. However Shauna overpowers Lok and claims the Amulet of Void. Victorious, the Spirals leave, burning Klaus' base to the ground in the process, with the team barely make it out alive. Zhalia is saddened at the loss of her only real home growing up while Dante must make a full report to the Huntik council. Lok and Sophie inform Lucas Casterwill of what has happened.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* This marks the third time (out of a total of five times) that an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode.
**When Rassimov moves in to attack Dante and reveals the Blood Spiral's motives at the end of the episode, he says: "Fear '''the Blood Spiral'''!".
* When Klaus is freed, he says "I'm out of it for a little while, and everyone gets delusions of grandeur", which is a reference to Han Solo's same line in the movie ''[[wikipedia:Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi|Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi]]''.
* When [[Hoffman]] casts [[Poisonfang]], the spell appears as a violet bolt instead of the usual green sludge, much like the spell's [[TCG:SAS-121|TCG card]].

full_text:
Prague, The Czech Republic

The Huntik team faces off against Lucas Casterwill, Sophie's brother. They come to an understanding and help find the missing Amulet of Void. Zhalia's plan lets them trick the Organization into revealing its location in Klaus' library. Lucas explains the history of the Betrayer, who tried to summon the Nullifiers in the past.

Synopsis

The Huntik team return to the lab of their old enemy, Klaus, where they face heavy resistance from Wilder and his team. However, both factions are soon ambushed by an even more deadly threat, the Blood Spiral...

Plot

Help from Klaus
At Huntik Foundation Italian HQ, the Huntik team find Klaus' statue, whom Zhalia turned to stone with King Basilisk. After turning him back, Zhalia and the team ask him for help to recover the Amulet of Void. Klaus recalls the stories of the Spiral Mark and devastation that would take place if the Amulet fell into the wrong hands. To the team's relief, he agrees to help.

Organization Territory
At Klaus's Bookstore, the team are ambushed by Wilder and the Organization. A fight ensues but the Huntik team defeat them and, with assistance from Springer, make their way down into the vault. They are ambushed again by Stack and Dark Dryad, but Lok manages to recover Void's Amulet from the vault. However, a alarming warning from a terrified Eathon Lambert via the Holotome tells Lok that something terrible is going to happen.

A New Faction
Both Factions are startled when another group arrives to claim Void: The Blood Spiral Brotherhood. With masses of Silent Soldiers, and their Titans, Harlekin and Marauder, the Blood Spiral are extremely powerful. Shauna and Wind defeat Wilder, Stack and the rest of the Organization easily. Dante attempts to disrupt the powerful Shakrit by using Archwarder, but their old enemy Rassimov emerges from the shadows and uses Darkvoid to destroy his Amulet. As the Spirals close in, it looks like the end for Dante.

The Powerbond
With one final chance, he calls on Caliban, powerbonding with the Titan and fighting back against the Spiral's powerful forces. However Shauna overpowers Lok and claims the Amulet of Void. Victorious, the Spirals leave, burning Klaus' base to the ground in the process, with the team barely make it out alive. Zhalia is saddened at the loss of her only real home growing up while Dante must make a full report to the Huntik council. Lok and Sophie inform Lucas Casterwill of what has happened.

Trivia

• This marks the third time (out of a total of five times) that an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode.
• • When Rassimov moves in to attack Dante and reveals the Blood Spiral's motives at the end of the episode, he says: "Fear the Blood Spiral!".
• When Klaus is freed, he says "I'm out of it for a little while, and everyone gets delusions of grandeur", which is a reference to Han Solo's same line in the movie Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi.
• When Hoffman casts Poisonfang, the spell appears as a violet bolt instead of the usual green sludge, much like the spell's TCG card.
